#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Field policy, duplicates, trailers, serialization and atomicity checks."""
import json, sys, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/submission')
import bridge as B

FAIL = []; COUNT = [0]
def check(name, cond, detail=''):
    COUNT[0] += 1
    if not cond:
        FAIL.append(name); print('FAIL', name, str(detail)[:600])
def run(routes, events): return B.bridge({'routes': routes, 'events': events})
def H(sid, fields): return {'sid': sid, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': fields}
def D(sid, hx): return {'sid': sid, 'type': 'data', 'hex': hx}
def U(sid, ft, hx): return {'sid': sid, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': ft, 'hex': hx}
def F(sid): return {'sid': sid, 'type': 'fin'}
def R(sid): return {'sid': sid, 'type': 'reset'}
def hdr(sid=0, method='GET', scheme='https', auth='demo.test', path='/', extra=()):
    f = [[':method', method], [':scheme', scheme], [':authority', auth], [':path', path]]; f.extend(extra); return H(sid, f)
def expect_request(method, path, host, fields, content=b'', trailers=None):
    out = bytearray()
    out += method + b' ' + path + b' HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: ' + host + b'\r\n'
    for n, v in fields: out += n + b': ' + v + b'\r\n'
    if trailers is None:
        out += b'content-length: %d\r\n\r\n' % len(content) + content
    else:
        out += b'transfer-encoding: chunked\r\n'
        if trailers:
            seen = []
            for n, v in trailers:
                if n not in seen: seen.append(n)
            out += b'trailer: ' + b', '.join(seen) + b'\r\n'
        out += b'\r\n'
        if content: out += b'%x\r\n' % len(content) + content + b'\r\n'
        out += b'0\r\n'
        for n, v in trailers: out += n + b': ' + v + b'\r\n'
        out += b'\r\n'
    return bytes(out)
RT = {'https://demo.test': 'a', 'https://alt.test': 'a', 'http://demo.test': 'b'}
def pipe(r, label='a'): return r['origins'][label]
def fwd(r, i=0): return r['streams'][i]

# --------------------------------------------------------- prohibited fields
def t_prohibited():
    for n in ['connection','proxy-connection','keep-alive','transfer-encoding','upgrade','http2-settings','trailer']:
        for v in ['', 'close', 'x']:
            check('prohib-%s-%s' % (n, v or 'empty'), run(RT, [hdr(extra=[[n,v]]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected', (n, v))
    # uppercase variants are invalid names anyway
    for n in ['Connection','TRANSFER-ENCODING','Trailer']:
        check('prohib-case-%s' % n, run(RT, [hdr(extra=[[n,'x']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected')

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- te
def t_te():
    check('te-ok', run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['te','trailers']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded')
    for v in ['trailers ', ' trailers', 'Trailers', 'trailers,x', 'gzip', '']:
        check('te-bad-%r' % v, run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['te',v]]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected', v)
    check('te-dup', run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['te','trailers'],['te','trailers']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected')
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['te','trailers'],['x-keep','v']]), F(0)])
    check('te-consumed', pipe(r) == expect_request(b'GET', b'/', b'demo.test', [(b'x-keep', b'v')]).hex(), pipe(r))

# ------------------------------------------------------------- content-length
def t_cl():
    ok_pairs = [([['content-length','0']], b''), ([['content-length','7']], b'1234567'),
                ([['content-length','007']], b'1234567'),
                ([['content-length','7, 7']], b'1234567'), ([['content-length','7,7']], b'1234567'),
                ([['content-length',' 7\t']], b'1234567'), ([['content-length','07, 7, 007']], b'1234567'),
                ([['content-length','7'],['content-length','07']], b'1234567'),
                ([['content-length','65536']], b'x'*65536)]
    for extra, body in ok_pairs:
        ev = [hdr(extra=extra)]
        n = len(body)
        for i in range(0, n, 1000): ev.append(D(0, body[i:i+1000].hex()))
        ev.append(F(0))
        r = run(RT, ev)
        check('cl-ok-%s' % extra[0][1][:12], fwd(r)['status'] == 'forwarded', (extra, fwd(r)))
        check('cl-pipe-%s' % extra[0][1][:12], pipe(r) == expect_request(b'GET', b'/', b'demo.test', [], body).hex())
    bad = ['1', '8', ' 8', '+7', '-7', '7.0', '0x7', '7 ', 'a', '7,', ',7', '7,,7', '', ' ', '\t',
           '7,8', '8,7', '007,8', ' \t7 \t ', '1e3', '7\r', '\x007']
    for v in bad:
        check('cl-bad-%r' % v, run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['content-length',v]]), D(0,'1234567'), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected', v)
    check('cl-missing-ok', run(RT, [hdr(), D(0,'abc'), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded')
    # huge numeral: 5000 digits, must not crash nor truncate
    huge = '0'*4999 + '3'
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['content-length', huge]]), D(0,'414243'), F(0)])
    check('cl-huge-mismatch', fwd(r)['status'] == 'rejected', fwd(r))
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['content-length', '0'*4999 + '3']]), D(0,'414243'), F(0)])
    check('cl-huge-match', fwd(r)['status'] == 'forwarded', fwd(r))
    huge2 = '9'*5000
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['content-length', huge2]]), F(0)])
    check('cl-huge2', fwd(r)['status'] == 'rejected', fwd(r))
    # equal even with trailers
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['content-length','3']]), D(0,'414243'), H(0,[['x-audit-q','1']]), F(0)])
    check('cl-with-trailers', fwd(r)['status'] == 'forwarded', fwd(r))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- cookie
def t_cookie():
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['cookie','a=1'],['x-mid','m'],['cookie','b=2'],['cookie','c=3']]), F(0)])
    check('cookie-join', pipe(r) == expect_request(b'GET', b'/', b'demo.test',
        [(b'cookie', b'a=1; b=2; c=3'), (b'x-mid', b'm')]).hex(), pipe(r))
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['cookie','a=1']]), F(0)])
    check('cookie-single', pipe(r) == expect_request(b'GET', b'/', b'demo.test', [(b'cookie', b'a=1')]).hex(), pipe(r))
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['cookie','']]), F(0)])
    check('cookie-empty', pipe(r) == b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncookie: \r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'.hex(), pipe(r))
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['cookie','a=1'],['cookie','']]), F(0)])
    check('cookie-empty-join', pipe(r) == b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncookie: a=1; \r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'.hex(), pipe(r))
    check('cookie-bad-val', run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['cookie','a=1\r\nx: 1']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected')

# ----------------------------------------------------------- repeatable lists
def t_lists():
    for n in ['accept','accept-encoding','cache-control','if-match','if-none-match','pragma','vary']:
        r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[[n,'v1'],[n,'v2']]), F(0)])
        check('list-%s' % n, fwd(r)['status'] == 'forwarded' and pipe(r) == expect_request(
            b'GET', b'/', b'demo.test', [(n.encode(), b'v1'), (n.encode(), b'v2')]).hex(), pipe(r))
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['x-list-hop','one'],['x-m','m'],['x-list-hop','two'],['x-list-','solo']]), F(0)])
    check('x-list', fwd(r)['status'] == 'forwarded' and pipe(r) == expect_request(b'GET', b'/', b'demo.test',
        [(b'x-list-hop', b'one'), (b'x-m', b'm'), (b'x-list-hop', b'two'), (b'x-list-', b'solo')]).hex(), pipe(r))
    check('x-list-empty-suffix-dup', run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['x-list-','a'],['x-list-','b']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected')
    for n in ['x-audit-a','range','if-range','if-modified-since','authorization','user-agent','x-custom','accept-language','date']:
        check('single-%s' % n, run(RT, [hdr(extra=[[n,'a'],[n,'b']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected', n)
        check('single-ok-%s' % n, run(RT, [hdr(extra=[[n,'a']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded', n)
    # x-audit- allowed as singleton in initial headers
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['x-audit-a','1'],['x-audit-a','2']]), F(0)])
    check('x-audit-initial-single', fwd(r)['status'] == 'rejected', fwd(r))
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['x-audit-a','1']]), F(0)])
    check('x-audit-initial-one', fwd(r)['status'] == 'forwarded' and pipe(r) == expect_request(
        b'GET', b'/', b'demo.test', [(b'x-audit-a', b'1')]).hex(), pipe(r))

# -------------------------------------------------------------------- trailers
def t_trailers():
    r = run(RT, [hdr(), D(0,'41424344'), H(0,[['x-audit-a','1'],['x-audit-b','2'],['x-audit-a','3']]), F(0)])
    check('trailer-basic', pipe(r) == expect_request(b'GET', b'/', b'demo.test', [], b'ABCD',
        [(b'x-audit-a', b'1'), (b'x-audit-b', b'2'), (b'x-audit-a', b'3')]).hex(), pipe(r))
    r = run(RT, [hdr(), H(0,[]), F(0)])
    check('trailer-empty', pipe(r) == b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n0\r\n\r\n'.hex(), pipe(r))
    r = run(RT, [hdr(), D(0,''), H(0,[['x-audit-a','']]), F(0)])
    check('trailer-empty-val', pipe(r) == (b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n'
        b'trailer: x-audit-a\r\n\r\n0\r\nx-audit-a: \r\n\r\n').hex(), pipe(r))
    for n in ['x-audit-', 'x-audits-a', 'audit-a', 'x-audit-A', 'content-length', 'x-list-a', 'X-AUDIT-a', ':method', 'x-audit-a b']:
        check('trailer-bad-%r' % n, run(RT, [hdr(), H(0,[[n,'1']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected', n)
    for v in [' lead', 'trail ', 'a\rb', '']:
        pass
    check('trailer-val-empty-ok', run(RT, [hdr(), H(0,[['x-audit-a','']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded')
    check('trailer-val-space', run(RT, [hdr(), H(0,[['x-audit-a',' x']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected')
    # empty content with trailers -> no chunk
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['content-length','0']]), H(0,[['x-audit-z','9']]), F(0)])
    check('trailer-nochunk', pipe(r) == expect_request(b'GET', b'/', b'demo.test', [], b'', [(b'x-audit-z', b'9')]).hex(), pipe(r))
    # one chunk regardless of segmentation
    r = run(RT, [hdr(), D(0,'41'), D(0,'42'), D(0,'43'), H(0,[['x-audit-z','9']]), F(0)])
    check('trailer-onechunk', b'3\r\nABC\r\n0\r\n' in bytes.fromhex(pipe(r)), pipe(r))

# ------------------------------------------------------- atomicity and order
def t_order():
    # FIN order not stream-id order
    r = run(RT, [hdr(4, auth='alt.test', path='/late'), hdr(0, path='/early'), F(0), D(4,'41'), F(4)])
    e0 = expect_request(b'GET', b'/early', b'demo.test', [])
    e4 = expect_request(b'GET', b'/late', b'alt.test', [], b'A')
    check('fin-order', pipe(r) == (e0 + e4).hex(), pipe(r))
    check('fin-order-off', (fwd(r,0)['offset'], fwd(r,1)['offset']) == (0, len(e0)), r['streams'])
    check('fin-order-commit', (fwd(r,0)['commit_at'], fwd(r,1)['commit_at']) == (3, 6), r['streams'])
    # rejected contributes nothing
    r = run(RT, [hdr(0, path='/ok'), hdr(4, path='/bad'), F(4), F(0)])
    check('rejected-nobytes', pipe(r) == expect_request(b'GET', b'/ok', b'demo.test', []).hex(), pipe(r))
    check('rejected-offset', fwd(r,0)['offset'] == 0 and fwd(r,0)['length'] == len(expect_request(b'GET', b'/ok', b'demo.test', [])), r['streams'])
    # interleaving with data
    ev = [hdr(0, method='POST', path='/p'), hdr(4, path='/q'), D(0,'11'), D(4,'22'), D(0,'33'), F(4), D(0,'44'), F(0)]
    r = run(RT, ev)
    check('interleave', pipe(r) == (expect_request(b'GET', b'/q', b'demo.test', [], b'\x22') +
        expect_request(b'POST', b'/p', b'demo.test', [], b'\x11\x33\x44')).hex(), pipe(r))
    # origins split and unused labels present
    r = run(RT, [hdr(0, scheme='http', path='/x'), F(0)])
    check('origin-split', r['origins'] == {'a': '', 'b': expect_request(b'GET', b'/x', b'demo.test', []).hex()}, r['origins'])
    check('origin-used', fwd(r)['origin'] == 'b', r)
    # sid sort
    r = run(RT, [hdr(8), F(8), hdr(0), F(0), hdr(4), F(4)])
    check('sid-sort', [s['sid'] for s in r['streams']] == [0, 4, 8], r['streams'])
    # null fields
    r = run(RT, [hdr(0, path='//bad'), F(0), D(4,'41'), R(4), hdr(8), U(12,33,'ff')])
    for i, st in [(0, 'rejected'), (1, 'cancelled'), (2, 'incomplete')]:
        s = fwd(r, i)
        check('null-%s' % st, s == {'sid': [0,4,8][i], 'status': st, 'commit_at': None, 'origin': None,
              'offset': None, 'length': 0, 'cache_key': None}, s)
    check('big-sid', run(RT, [hdr(4611686018427387900), F(4611686018427387900)])['streams'][0]['sid'] == 4611686018427387900)

# ------------------------------------------------------------- serialization
def t_serialize():
    # empty value field, several fields preserved exactly
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['x-empty',''],['x-tab','a\tb'],['x-hi','\xe9\xff'],['x-sp','a b']]), F(0)])
    exp = (b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\nx-empty: \r\nx-tab: a\tb\r\nx-hi: \xe9\xff\r\n'
           b'x-sp: a b\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
    check('ser-exact', pipe(r) == exp.hex(), pipe(r))
    # body with CRLF, NUL, request-smuggling lookalike
    body = b'GET /evil HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n\x00\r\n\r\nPOST /x HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
    r = run(RT, [hdr(method='POST', path='/p'), D(0, body.hex()), F(0)])
    check('ser-body', pipe(r) == (expect_request(b'POST', b'/p', b'demo.test', [], body)).hex(), pipe(r))
    # 65536 body content-length decimal
    r = run(RT, [hdr(method='POST'), D(0, 'ab'*65536), F(0)])
    check('ser-65536', b'content-length: 65536\r\n\r\n' + b'ab'*65536 == bytes.fromhex(pipe(r)), len(bytes.fromhex(pipe(r))))
    # chunk size hex lowercase, no leading zeros
    body = b'z'*255
    r = run(RT, [hdr(method='PUT'), D(0, body.hex()), H(0,[['x-audit-k','v']]), F(0)])
    check('ser-chunk-hex', b'\r\nff\r\n' + body + b'\r\n0\r\n' in bytes.fromhex(pipe(r)), pipe(r)[-40:])
    body = b'z'*65536
    r = run(RT, [hdr(method='PUT'), D(0, body.hex()), H(0,[['x-audit-k','v']]), F(0)])
    check('ser-chunk-10000', b'\r\n10000\r\n' + body + b'\r\n0\r\n' in bytes.fromhex(pipe(r)), pipe(r)[-60:])
    # host line canonical, cache key canonical, route canonical agree
    r = run({'https://alt.test': 'a'}, [hdr(auth='ALT.test:443'), F(0)])
    check('canon-agree', pipe(r).startswith(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: alt.test\r\n'.hex()) and
          fwd(r)['cache_key'] == ['GET','https','alt.test','/'], (pipe(r)[:60], fwd(r)))
    # OPTIONS * request line
    r = run(RT, [hdr(method='OPTIONS', path='*'), F(0)])
    check('ser-star', pipe(r).startswith(b'OPTIONS * HTTP/1.1\r\n'.hex()), pipe(r)[:40])
    # latin-1 in path is rejected, but high bytes in values kept as single octets
    r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['x-v','\u00ff\u0080']]), F(0)])
    check('ser-high-octets', b'x-v: \xff\x80\r\n' in bytes.fromhex(pipe(r)), pipe(r))

for fn in (t_prohibited, t_te, t_cl, t_cookie, t_lists, t_trailers, t_order, t_serialize):
    fn()
print('checks:', COUNT[0], 'failures:', len(FAIL))
sys.exit(1 if FAIL else 0)
